title: Pollard-walk counts of 100 butterfly species on 22 transects of the Sierra Nevada Global-Change Observatory, Spain, 2008-2020 (without IUCN-threatened species, coordinates as published)
creator: Barea-Azcón, José Miguel; Ros Candeira, Andrea
citation: Barea-Azcón J M (2021). Dataset of butterfly monitoring in Sierra Nevada (Spain). Version 1.2. Sierra Nevada Global-Change Observatory (UGR-JA). Sampling event dataset. https://doi.org/10.15470/tc3gdq (CC BY 4.0).
abstract: Butterfly line transects of the Sierra Nevada Global-Change Observatory (Andalusia, Spain): 22 transects from 700 to 3,100 m a.s.l. in high-mountain grassland and scrub, oak and pine forest, pastures and wetlands, walked about every two weeks from March to October, 2008-2020 (none in 2011). 1,725 walks, 109 with no butterfly; counts summed over the sections of a walk; 102 species. This table omits Carcharodus baeticus and Polyommatus golgus (IUCN VU, EN) so that the transect centroids, elevations and localities ship as published; barea_2021_sierranevada_butterfly_count has every species with coarsened locations.
samplingProtocol: Pollard & Yates line transect: every butterfly within 5 m to each side and 5 m ahead and above counted per section, netted and released where identification needed it; walks in suitable weather; transects 300-3,270 m (mean 1,900 m).
occasionLength: one transect walk (start and end time in obs_start_time / obs_end_time)
surveyEvidenceNote: Every walk is a parent event in event.txt (1,725), including 109 with no section event and no occurrence (walks with no butterfly); section events exist only where a butterfly was counted, and every occurrence belongs to a section of a listed walk.
closureNote: not assumed: walks every two weeks from March to October follow each species' flight period; period = calendar year

geographicCoverage.description: Sierra Nevada National and Natural Park, Granada and Almería, Spain (22 transects, 700-3,100 m a.s.l.)

coordinatesCoarsened.method: As published (transect centroids): the IUCN-threatened Carcharodus baeticus, Polyommatus golgus are not in this table (E7.3)

notShipped.section counts: summed over the sections of each walk into y; empty sections have no event and the section count per transect is not stated
notShipped.records to genus or family: 1,239 genus-level and 276 family-level records of butterflies not identified to species; the species zeros at those walks stay as recorded
notShipped.infraspecificEpithet: Coenonympha pamphilus lyllus (500 records), merged into Coenonympha pamphilus
notShipped.recordedBy: observer names, replaced by pseudonymous team ids
notShipped.footprintWKT: route geometry of each transect, finer than the published centroid
notShipped.threatened species: Carcharodus baeticus, Polyommatus golgus (IUCN VU, EN): in barea_2021_sierranevada_butterfly_count only, whose locations are coarsened
